key.name: profile-ids
key.description: Array of profile IDs defining the order and availability of profiles.

key.name: active-profile-id
key.description: The profile currently used by runtime and quick settings.

key.name: last-active-profile-id
key.description: The last real profile that was active, remembered for Quick Settings restore. Empty when no profile has been remembered.

key.name: pointer-menu-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the per-monitor mode menu at the pointer. Use an empty list in dconf or Clear in preferences to disable the shortcut.

key.name: idle-timeout-seconds
key.description: Time without pointer activity on the target monitor before blacking it.

key.name: keep-awake-minutes
key.description: How long Keep Awake remains active.

key.name: show-quick-settings-menu
key.description: Show the extension's menu in the GNOME quick settings panel.

key.name: show-issue-notifications
key.description: Show user-facing notifications when the extension logs warnings or errors.

key.name: disable-auto-timer-on-pointer-monitor
key.summary: Disable auto timer on pointer monitor
key.description: Disable the auto timer for the monitor currently under the pointer.

key.name: disable-window-obstruction-policy
key.summary: Disable compositor workaround for maximized/fullscreen windows
key.description: Disable the GNOME compositor workaround that prevents rendering issues when overlays overlap fullscreen or maximized windows.

key.name: dim-intensity-percent
key.description: Target black overlay intensity from 0 to 100 percent.

key.name: known-monitors
key.description: JSON array of known monitor identities and their display labels, persisted by the extension for the prefs process. Format: [{"monitorId":"...","label":"..."}]

key.name: monitor-modes
key.description: JSON object mapping monitor IDs to their configured modes (auto, keep-awake, disabled, manual-black).
